result.instructions: Tools for Formcrafts, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our forms got responses in the last 7 days?"; "Show the latest 20 responses to our contact form."; "List the partial (unfinished) responses to the demo request form.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Formcrafts data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run formcrafts_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run formcrafts_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run formcrafts_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. formcrafts_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: formcrafts_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces in the Formcrafts organization (id, name, created_at). Good first call to find a workspace id for form lists. GET /v2/workspaces.

before.description: Only items created before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Pagination on created_at.

after.description: Only items created after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Pagination on created_at.

tools.name: formcrafts_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms in the organization: id, name, workspace_id, enabled, created_at and updated_at (last published). GET /v2/forms.

before.description: Only items created before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Pagination on created_at.

after.description: Only items created after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Pagination on created_at.

tools.name: formcrafts_get_form
tools.title: Get form details
tools.description: Get one form: its fields (id, type, page, label, required), pages, enabled flag, response count and dates. GET /v2/forms/{id}.

tools.name: formcrafts_list_form_responses
tools.title: List form responses
tools.description: List the live responses of one form: visitor data, the answers per field (field_id, value_type, value) and timestamps. Set partial=true to return only unfinished (partial) responses. GET /v2/forms/{id}/responses.

before.description: Only items created before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Pagination on created_at.

after.description: Only items created after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Pagination on created_at.

tools.name: formcrafts_list_files
tools.title: List uploaded files
tools.description: List the files uploaded through forms in the organization: id, name, MIME type, size and dates. GET /v2/files.

before.description: Only items created before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Pagination on created_at.

after.description: Only items created after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Pagination on created_at.

tools.name: formcrafts_get_file_content
tools.title: Get file content
tools.description: Get the content of one uploaded file. Text files (text/*, JSON, XML) return up to 200 KB of text. Other types return only their MIME type and size. GET /v2/files/{id}/content.
